title: Platform Cross-Over Analysis
scenario: Find games that appear on at least 3 different platforms, and for those games, find the average critic score across all platforms.
tableSchema: ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR, critic_score NUMERIC)
correctQuery: SELECT game_id, AVG(critic_score) FROM ratings GROUP BY game_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT platform) >= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR, critic_score NUMERIC);
